summary: Implement an automated completion-governance layer that distinguishes release readiness from roadmap completion, then wires it into CI and workflow task queues.
approach: Deliver in five incremental tasks: build checkbox completion checker, integrate staged CI gates (soft→hard), export unchecked roadmap items as execution queue artifacts, align README task source, and optionally surface completion signal in release summary.

design_decisions.decision: Use docs/TASKS_V10_OPTIMIZED.md as the completion source of truth
design_decisions.rationale: It is the only existing file with explicit unchecked roadmap items
design_decisions.tradeoff: Requires README link alignment to avoid source drift

design_decisions.decision: Adopt staged CI governance (soft warn first, hard fail conditionally)
design_decisions.rationale: Avoid immediate disruption while introducing measurable completion guardrails
design_decisions.tradeoff: Temporary period where incomplete roadmap does not block all builds
